props.description:
Merge: whenever any creature's Burn triggers, recover 2% of your Max HP and MP.

Pulse: uses your action, no MP. 3 Burn stacks on up to three creatures.

Dismiss: free, at the start or end of your turn. 30 Fire damage to all enemies, then the merge ends. For 6 ZP, add 10 damage per Burn stack and clear their Burn.

exBxZ5rirKCIKQJq.skill_description:
As a free action, before or after your action on your turn, you release the Avatar in a final blaze, dealing 【30】 Fire damage to all enemies and ending the merge.

As you do, you may spend 【6 Zero Power】 to deal additional Fire damage to each enemy equal to 【10 × their Burn stacks】, then remove all Burn from those enemies.

props.name: Avatar of Vengeance
